# shadcn Full Guide

Use this guide for composable UI primitives and accessible component design.

## Scope

- Primitive selection and composition
- Accessibility behavior
- Variant and API consistency
- Styling integration with utility classes

## Core Playbook

1. Compose from primitives with clear APIs.
2. Validate keyboard/focus behavior.
3. Standardize variants and state handling.
4. Keep implementation portable and testable.
